title: Supreme Court rejects Trump request to set aside California ballots
paragraphs: The United States Supreme Court has declined to intervene on behalf of President Donald Trump’s administration in its bid to force California not to count the ballots of more than 20,000 voters it claims are not citizens.

The Department of Justice had filed an emergency request earlier in the day, just one day before the US midterm elections. It is the latest development in a legal battle between the administration and California, a Democratic stronghold and the most populous US state.
California says the move could disenfranchise thousands of eligible voters.
